notes: Pandas loads the complete dataset into RAM and applies C-optimized vectorized operations.

MapReduce processes records sequentially or in chunks, emitting key-value pairs followed by partitioned grouping (Shuffle) and parallel aggregation (Reduce). Lower peak memory usage than single-process in-memory loads on large datasets.

PySpark is currently unavailable: PySpark library is not installed in the current Python environment (pip install pyspark). To enable Spark: Install PySpark via `pip install pyspark`, ensure Java 8/11/17 is in PATH, and on Windows configure winutils.exe if running HDFS operations.
